review_state: PARTIAL; modified counter-sales parent source reviewed; clean baseline test used as test evidence; request-race, PII fixture, server boundary, and browser QA remain open

paths_reviewed.review_notes: The patch mainly extracts presentation markup/styles and adds typed model mapping plus form update handlers; parent remains state/service owner. Service calls and sale-transition bodies are unchanged in the diff. A stale response risk and payment-validation boundary are recorded below.

reference_test.working_tree_status: clean tracked file; not a modified inventory path
reference_test.used_as: Focused UI behavior evidence only; not counted in the original 386 dirty-path denominator.

source_diff.assessment: Most of the removal is extracted card/workbench template and styles. Added code maps filtered sale summaries into readonly CounterSalesCardModel values and validates/normalizes typed catalog, barcode, and payment field updates. Existing service mutation methods were not changed by this diff.

test_execution.environment: Standalone SPA Vitest/JSDOM config; counter-sales, owner, patient, product, inventory, quote, encounter, and medical-record service imports are mocked; window.open is mocked. No database, provider, or network call observed.

workflow_review: Parent owns selected-sale state, forms, service calls, and mutations. Tests exercise item/payment requests, atomic settle when balance remains, direct close when paid, cancellation reason validation/history, barcode item submission, create-owner flow, owner pagination, and reception handoff context.

Cancellation reason rejects control characters, trims whitespace, requires nonempty text, caps at 500 characters; tests cover trimmed reason, control-character/whitespace rejection, and an oversized reason.

Operational print HTML escapes interpolated owner, patient, item, payment, note, and id strings before document.write. The print test only asserts the mocked popup path; it does not assert generated HTML escaping or browser print behavior.

Payment amount updates normalize to a minimum of zero. The page does not locally require a strictly positive amount or cap it at balance before submit/settle; authoritative API validation was not exercised.

findings_and_limits.observation: loadPage and selectSale start concurrent async requests without a generation token or cancellation. A slower prior filter load or sale selection can update sales/paymentForm after a newer selection; tests do not cover out-of-order completion. This is an observed UI state race risk, not a proven persistence defect.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Decide whether to serialize/cancel/generation-guard requests and add a deferred-response regression test before candidate inclusion.

findings_and_limits.observation: The clean test present on origin/main includes CPF-shaped and phone-number-shaped fixture data. It appears synthetic, but provenance was not established in this source review. This is a baseline file and not a dirty path or overlay addition.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Confirm synthetic provenance or use a clearly reserved fixture before external publication; do not treat a pattern scan as full privacy review.

findings_and_limits.observation: The page accepts zero as a normalized payment amount and forwards it to addPayment/settle; no authoritative API/database validation was exercised.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Verify API rejects zero/invalid/over-balance payment amounts in candidate-bound tests; retain server as authority.

candidate_actions.hold_reason: The modified page source is hash-stable and reviewed. Request-race disposition, baseline fixture provenance, authoritative payment validation, complete privacy review, browser QA, independent critique, and remaining inventory coverage are open.

limitations: The 12 passing tests use mocks; they establish asserted UI payloads and states only, not persistence, tenant enforcement, idempotency, stock consistency, payment ledger, or transaction behavior.
Browser print, payment integration, viewport layout, keyboard/focus, screen-reader behavior, and visual parity were not tested in a real browser.
This round counts only CounterSalesPage.vue; its clean baseline test is a reference and is outside the 386 dirty-path denominator.
Review is primary-operator inspection and is not independent acceptance.
